programs.name: robust_19_pulse_trend
programs.description: Use when minute-level data has resumed a stable 19-point cycle consisting of a five-point elevated pulse and a gradually rising baseline after an earlier disruption.
programs.assumption: Across the latest two complete 19-point cycle transitions, the median per-step cycle drift remains positive and the median absolute deviation of 19-lag differences is below 1.0; under this condition, a detrended 19-phase template has lower rolling SMAPE than the parent model whose worst observed fold scored 44.317.
programs.failure_condition: It fails if the pulse changes phase or duration, the 19-lag difference MAD exceeds 1.0, or the series undergoes another reset comparable to the historical run of zeros.
